# BigQuery observations for geography_centroid

SELECT ST_CENTROID(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT(10 20)'))
=> "POINT(10 20)"

SELECT ST_CENTROID(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT EMPTY'))
=> "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION EMPTY"

SELECT ST_CENTROID(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTIPOINT(0 0, 10 0, 10 0)'))
=> "POINT(5 0)"

SELECT ST_CENTROID(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTIPOINT(0 0, 180 0)'))
=> "POINT(90 0)"

SELECT ST_CENTROID(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTIPOINT(-30 0, 150 0)'))
=> "POINT(0 0)"

SELECT ST_CENTROID(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTIPOINT(0 90, 0 -90)'))
=> "POINT(0 0)"

SELECT ST_CENTROID(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('fullglobe'))
=> "POINT(0 0)"

SELECT ST_CENTROID(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 10 0, 10 20)'))
=> "POINT(8.31248132118172 6.66757002200199)"

SELECT ST_CENTROID(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((0 0, 10 0, 0 10, 0 0))'))
=> "POINT(3.34995688929909 3.34424564153806)"

SELECT ST_CENTROID(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('GEOMETRYCOLLECTION(POINT(100 30), LINESTRING(0 0, 10 0))'))
=> "POINT(5 0)"

SELECT ST_CENTROID(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('GEOMETRYCOLLECTION(LINESTRING(100 0, 110 0), POLYGON((0 0, 10 0, 0 10, 0 0)))'))
=> "POINT(3.34995688929909 3.34424564153806)"

SELECT ST_CENTROID(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('MULTILINESTRING((0 0, 10 0), (20 0, 20 30))'))
=> "POINT(16.1383904958199 11.3096053110835)"

SELECT ST_CENTROID(CAST(NULL AS GEOGRAPHY))
=> null
